migrationDdl.name: migrations/0012_stage_run_records.sql (after 0011a on origin/main at PR time)
migrationDdl.columns: id uuid pk default gen_random_uuid(); county_fips text not null; stage smallint not null; stage_detail text not null default ''; run_id uuid references runs(id) -- NULLABLE, for dry runs; run_mode text not null ('apply'|'dry-run'); started_at timestamptz not null; ended_at timestamptz; outcome text not null ('running'|'succeeded'|'failed'|'killed'|'orphaned'|'refused'); instrument_verdict text; instrument_artifact_path text; rows_written bigint; rows_written_basis text; manifest_pin jsonb; compute_cost_usd numeric(14,6); compute_cost_basis jsonb; compute_cost_unmeasured_reason text; operator_minutes numeric(10,2); operator_minutes_basis jsonb; operator_minutes_unmeasured_reason text; created_at/updated_at timestamptz not null default now().
migrationDdl.theThreeStatesInTheSchema: CONSTRAINT stage_run_records_compute_three_states_check CHECK ((compute_cost_usd IS NOT NULL AND compute_cost_basis IS NOT NULL AND compute_cost_unmeasured_reason IS NULL) OR (compute_cost_usd IS NULL AND compute_cost_unmeasured_reason IS NOT NULL)); the same shape for operator_minutes; plus compute_cost_usd IS NULL OR >= 0 so a measured ZERO stays legal; plus operator_minutes_basis ? 'declaredBy' AND ? 'declaredAt' AND ? 'stopPoint', so a declared value names who declared it, when, and at which stop point.
migrationDdl.otherConstraints: county_fips ~ '^[0-9]{5}$'; stage BETWEEN 0 AND 12; run_mode in ('apply','dry-run'); run_mode <> 'apply' OR run_id IS NOT NULL; outcome = 'running' OR ended_at IS NOT NULL; ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= started_at; rows_written IS NULL OR >= 0.
migrationDdl.identity: UNIQUE (run_id, county_fips, stage, coalesce(stage_detail,'')) WHERE run_id IS NOT NULL, and UNIQUE (county_fips, stage, coalesce(stage_detail,''), started_at) WHERE run_id IS NULL.
migrationDdl.views: stage_run_speed (one row per county/stage/sub-stage, with the unmeasured COUNTED), stage_run_speed_per_10k (the same normalised by parcel_record, carrying parcels_basis), stage_run_comparison (two counties, one row per stage, ratios stated from county_a's side).
migrationDdl.durability: Nothing in the migration's SQL references leases; the row is durable on its own, so releasing a lease cannot remove it. A test asserts this against the SQL with the comments stripped, and asserts the file still DOES discuss leases in prose so the check is about the SQL and not about a deletion.

finding1_theComparisonWasSilentForACount.whatTheFirstVersionDid: compareCounties read stage_run_comparison directly. The view is correct for the case F3 states: it builds its key set from the two counties' own records, so a stage present in either county appears with missing_a/missing_b set (probe output, above).
finding1_theComparisonWasSilentForACount.whatItCouldNotDo: A county with NO records at all has no row for the key CTE to read, so asking the view about that county returns ZERO ROWS. Zero rows reads as 'nothing to report', not as 'this county cannot be compared yet' -- and the question the table exists for is literally 'Bell and Milam beat Burnet', asked while Burnet has not run yet.
finding1_theComparisonWasSilentForACount.fix: compareCounties builds the pair from the counties it was ASKED about, returns coverage and comparable alongside the rows, and cli.mjs 'stage-runs compare' exits 4 when the pair is not comparable so a script cannot read 'not comparable' as success.
finding1_theComparisonWasSilentForACount.theRiskThisIntroducedAndHowItIsGuarded: The ratio expressions are now duplicated between the function and the view. That is a paired implementation, which is exactly the shape DEV_PROCESS says drifts, so a live test asserts the function and the view AGREE on a pair where both counties have data -- edit one without the other and the test fails.
finding1_theComparisonWasSilentForACount.observed: cli.mjs stage-runs compare --a 48453 --b 48021 with records for only one side printed { county_a: 48021, county_b: 48453, coverage: { 48021: 0, 48453: 1 }, comparable: false, rows: [ ... one stage row with missing_a true-like nulls and explicit missing flags ... ] } and exited 4.

finding2_theCompletenessSweepWasBlindAnd.whatTheFirstVersionDid: the stage-map completeness test matched only `phase: "literal"` across src/ and went green over 40 phases.
finding2_theCompletenessSweepWasBlindAnd.whatItMissed: SEVENTEEN assignment sites name their phase through a const (`phase: JOB_ID` with `const JOB_ID = "..."` in the same file). Resolving the const surfaced SIXTEEN phases that had never been decided, all of them live jobs -- acquisition, ten rail writers, an atom re-stamp, the gate scheduler, and a containment persist.
finding2_theCompletenessSweepWasBlindAnd.whyThisMattersMoreThanTheFix: The test's whole purpose is to make a new job unable to escape the missing-record audit. A literal-only sweep is bypassed by writing the job the way seventeen existing jobs already are, so the guard was weakest exactly where the repo's own convention would take a new contributor. This is DEV_PROCESS's 'an empty result is not an absence' applied to a test's own coverage: green meant 'I looked at a subset', not 'there is nothing there'.
finding2_theCompletenessSweepWasBlindAnd.fix: the sweep resolves a const declared in the same file, asserts at least one such site exists (so the branch cannot go vacuous), and skips comment lines -- the module's own doc block quotes the pattern being searched for, so a sweep that reads prose would demand a stage number for a sentence.
finding2_theCompletenessSweepWasBlindAnd.theFortyOneEntries: 15 of the 16 carry a stage read off their own header, with the evidence quoted into the entry and marked provisional: true because each is a reading of a stated purpose rather than a computed value. P-285 (whose plan row says it 'writes P-284's records') confirms or corrects them. The stage 3 / stage 6 boundary is stated from both sides: acquire-school-district is 3 because it takes a live source, parcel-school-district is 6 because the source is staged. owner-rail-collision-check is DECLINED -- its header describes a disagreement CHECK between two owner claims, so it verifies and fills no rail. p2-juris-containment is NEITHER mapped NOR declined: its header calls it a 'containment-persist' job, which could be stage 4 (identity and binding) or stage 6 (a rail), and a guessed stage number is worse than a stated gap because the per-stage cost roll-up would report the guess as fact. It goes in PHASE_UNASSIGNED, stageForPhase gives it its own reason, and the audit counts it in buckets.unassigned.

finding3_myChangeBrokeTwoExistingTestsAn.what: test/parcel-envelope-cells.test.mjs and test/parcel-setback-cells.test.mjs drove the jobs with `factory = { query: async () => ({ rows: [] }) }`. The stage writer reads the id from `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id`, so an empty row set is indistinguishable from a conflict, and the run refused with STAGE_RECORD_ALREADY_OPEN. Both tests failed.
finding3_myChangeBrokeTwoExistingTestsAn.whatIDidInsteadOfSpecialCasingTheCode: the doubles now answer the three statements the writer actually runs (the stage INSERT, the run lookup, the stage UPDATE) and the tests assert the record is opened EXACTLY ONCE and CLOSED, which is a stronger assertion than the one they had. A fake that returns no rows for every statement is not a model of RETURNING, and weakening the writer to suit it would have removed the conflict detection that stops one run's stage being recorded twice.
finding3_myChangeBrokeTwoExistingTestsAn.also_caught_here: openStageRun used to report 'a stage record already exists ... id ?' when the read-back found nothing, i.e. it inferred a conflict from an absence. It now distinguishes 'the identity exists' from 'the store did not answer the write' (STAGE_RECORD_UNWRITABLE), and the dry-run read-back keys on started_at so the refusal names the row that actually occupied the identity rather than the latest dry run for that county.

residualsAndWhatTheIntegrationSeatMustDo.1_applyTheMigrationToStaging: 0012 is unapplied by design. Applying it is the integration seat's first act and the row stays closed-partial until a real staging run writes a record.
residualsAndWhatTheIntegrationSeatMustDo.2_recheckTheMigrationNumber: 0012 was the next free number at PR time; P-252 adds one concurrently. Re-check before merge.
residualsAndWhatTheIntegrationSeatMustDo.3_thePendingWriterSetIsTwentyOneStagesWi: Only stage 6's depth writers actually write records today. Stage 6's other eleven writers, plus stages 1, 3, 4, 5, 7, 9 and 10, are mapped with writesRecords: false and ownerRow P-285. Their runs are COUNTED by the audit, not failed. The map is built so that when P-285 wires each one, its phase moves to writesRecords: true and the audit starts failing on it that day -- nothing has to be remembered.
residualsAndWhatTheIntegrationSeatMustDo.4_onePhaseHasNoStage: p2-juris-containment is reported in buckets.unassigned with its reason. It needs a stage number from whoever owns it, because until then its cost cannot be rolled up per stage.
residualsAndWhatTheIntegrationSeatMustDo.5_theFifteenProvisionalStageReadings: Fifteen entries are marked provisional: true (eleven stage-6 rail writers, one stage-3 acquirer, one stage-4 bind writer, one stage-7 atom re-stamp, one stage-9 gate scheduler). Each quotes the header line it was read from. P-285 should confirm them in one pass rather than re-derive them.
residualsAndWhatTheIntegrationSeatMustDo.6_noCostHasEverBeenMeasuredAgainstARealE: computeCostForExecution's arithmetic is unit-tested against a synthetic billable series and the rate table is pinned, but no Cloud Run execution has been priced end to end by this lane (that would need a real execution's monitoring series). The first staging run is the first real measurement, and METRIC_NOT_YET_PUBLISHED is the state a self-measuring job will land in until the reaper backfills it.
residualsAndWhatTheIntegrationSeatMustDo.7_operatorMinutesHasNoDeclarerYet: The column, the basis and the CHECK exist and the environment plumbing (FACTORY_OPERATOR_MINUTES / stop point) is in place, but nothing in the fleet declares operator minutes today, so every real record will carry an unmeasured reason until a runbook or the runner (P-285) declares one. That is the honest state, not a defect.
